releaseNotes: The new BANG TV. Live TV with a full guide you can filter by category, Movies and Shows with cover art and details, Sports, MultiView, recordings, favorites and your own lists, themes, and a phone remote. Installs next to the older BANG TV app; set up your playlist once.
